name: Coal India Ltd
about: Coal India Ltd is mainly engaged in mining and production of Coal and also operates Coal washeries. The major consumers of the company are power and steel sectors. Consumers from other sectors include cement, fertilizers, brick kilns
keyPoints: A Maharatna Company [1] [2] [3] The company was incorporated in 1972 as Coal Mines Authority Limited and renamed CIL in November 1975 following the nationalisation of the coal sector. It is a Maharatna CPSE under the Ministry of Coal and has 9 wholly owned subsidiaries, 5 other subsidiaries, and 5 joint ventures, including a foreign subsidiary. The Government of India’s stake declined from 63% as of Mar 2026 to 61% in Jun 2026 following the OFS, in which it sold a total of 2% stake.
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 6.90%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 37.9%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 46.8%

announcements.text: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') - Initial Public O?ering ('IPO') Of Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs 2 Each ('Equity Shares') Of Mahanadi Coalfield Limited, A Subsidiary Of Coal India Limited ('Company') 24 Nov - Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields files prospectus for IPO of 661.84 mn shares via offer for sale.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 23 Nov - Deepak Saxena and Binay Kumar Jha promoted as Executive Directors, Coal India senior management personnel.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 21 Nov - Coal India announces senior management change; Debabrata Ghosh and Rajesh V Nair promoted as Executive Directors.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Bagging/receiving of order(s) or contract(s) 19 Nov - Coal India, with NFTDC, receives MHI LoI for 1,200 TPA rare earth permanent magnet facility.
Filing Of RHP Of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of CIL, With SEBI 14 Nov - MCL filed RHP for IPO; CIL may sell up to 661,836,300 shares.
